name: 48146 · Lincoln Park, MI
findings: ZIP 48146 (Lincoln Park) has 58 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 48146 (Lincoln Park) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 48146 (Lincoln Park) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
